mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.parent_id as parentId, m.link_url as path, m.link_url as component, m.icon, m.sort_order as sortOrder, m.status as visible, m.status as enabled, m.tenant_id as tenantId FROM menu_page m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.delflag = 0 AND m.tenant_id = 'default' AND ( -- 通过岗位的menu_ids字段匹配 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workposition wp WHERE wp.id = #{positionId} AND wp.tenant_id = 'default' AND wp.status = 1 AND wp.delflag = 0 AND FIND_IN_SET(m.id, wp.menu_ids) > 0 ) ) ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort_order ASC

SELECT DISTINCT mf.id, mf.menu_page_id as menuId, mf.perm_name as name, mf.perm_code as code, mf.description, mf.sort_order as sortOrder, 1 as enabled, mf.tenant_id as tenantId FROM menu_func mf WHERE mf.menu_page_id = #{menuId} AND mf.tenant_id = 'default' ORDER BY mf.sort_order ASC

SELECT id, name, parent_id as parentId, link_url as path, link_url as component, icon, sort_order as sortOrder, status as visible, status as enabled, tenant_id as tenantId FROM menu_page WHERE status = 1 AND delflag = 0 AND tenant_id = 'default' ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC

SELECT id, name, parent_id as parentId, link_url as path, link_url as component, icon, sort_order as sortOrder, status as visible, status as enabled, tenant_id as tenantId, created_at as createdAt, created_at as updatedAt FROM menu_page WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT id, name, parent_id as parentId, link_url as path, link_url as component, icon, sort_order as sortOrder, status, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '启用' WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' ELSE '未知' END as statusDesc, CASE WHEN parent_id = 0 OR parent_id IS NULL THEN 'menu' ELSE 'button' END as type, tenant_id as tenantId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM menu_page WHERE delflag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC
